description: This file defines the AdminReviewMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface. It is responsible for configuring a specific menu item related to the performance review search screen within the OrangeHRM Performance module by overriding the current screen with 'searchEvaluatePerformanceReview'.

classes.name: AdminReviewMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for the performance review search screen in the HRM system.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'searchEvaluatePerformanceReview' for the admin review menu.
